His psychotic symptoms have improved, making persistent psychosis-driven agitation less likely. Neurological exam is otherwise normal (no dystonia, rigidity, tremor, or choreiform movements), labs and vitals are unremarkable, and there is no fever or autonomic instability to suggest NMS. Timing and presentation are most consistent with an extrapyramidal adverse effect of antipsychotics—specifically akathisia—rather than acute dystonia, parkinsonism, tardive dyskinesia, or other medical causes. Risperidone is a known cause of medication-induced akathisia. 
DIAGNOSIS: Antipsychotic-induced akathisia (medication-induced akathisia).
